flows.name: An AI manager answers a creator's messages and calls them in when needed (ChatPlace)
flows.summary: ChatPlace's home page, for creators and small businesses on Instagram, TikTok and Telegram: "Let AI handle your messages".

steps.what: Sends a DM, a comment or a tag on the creator's account.
Understands the context and replies, in the creator's manner ("chats like you"), keeping the audience engaged and selling around the clock.
Saves client data and tracks common and missed questions.
steps.agent: Keeps the record of the conversations.

steps.what: Is notified when to step into the conversation.
Feeds the rest of the creator's system: points for engagement, sales funnels and broadcasts, audience segments exported to payment systems, Google Sheets and other services.
